cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial maintenance screen renders with header, key fields and the entry prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has just started the Transaction Type Maintenance transaction (ORTT); no data has been entered yet.
cases.steps:
1. Sign on and select Transaction Type Maintenance (transaction ORTT) from the main menu.
2. Observe the screen as first displayed.
cases.expected: The maintenance screen opens with the header line showing Tran `ORTT`, Pgm `OCTTYP`, the system title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM` and the current date and time; the captions `Type Code:` and `Desc     :` are shown with empty input fields; the bottom legend reads `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear`; the message line shows `Enter a type code and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 MTTYPA / mapset MTTYP · 0000-MAIN (EIBCALEN=0) → 1000-SEND-INITIAL · 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · WS-M-PROMPT · legend literal L24 of MTTYP.bms

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the input fields are empty, the cursor rests on Type Code and the state is key-entry
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction (ORTT) has just been started (first entry, no commarea).
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORTT.
2. Observe the initial values and cursor position.
cases.expected: The Type Code and Desc fields are both blank; the cursor rests on the Type Code field; the message line shows `Enter a type code and press ENTER.`; the screen is at the key-entry state ('K') so a save (PF5) is not yet possible.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTTYPAO · MOVE -1 TO TTCDL (cursor) · WS-M-PROMPT · CA-WORK-AREA(1:1)='K' (WS-ST-KEY) · MOVE 1 TO CA-PGM-CONTEXT

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Header shows the ISO date and HH:MM:SS time; fields use the intended colours
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORTT.
2. Observe the header date and time and the field colours.
cases.expected: The header shows the current date in ISO form (`2026-09-28`) and the time as `HH:MM:SS` (e.g. `09:15:42`); the title is shown in yellow, the captions in blue, the two input fields in green and the message line in red.
cases.remark: 8500-GET-DATE-TIME: ASKTIME + FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') YYYYMMDD(WS-HDR-DATE) TIME(WS-HDR-TIME) TIMESEP(':') · BMS colours TITLE YELLOW / captions BLUE / TTCD,TTDESC GREEN / ERRMSG RED

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Type code left blank is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Type Code blank.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected; the message line shows `Type code is required.` and the cursor returns to the Type Code field; no record is looked up.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP: IF TTCDI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → MOVE WS-M-CD-REQ TO ERRMSGO, MOVE -1 TO TTCDL → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY (no 3000-READ-TTYP)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A blank description is rejected when saving
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `08`; the operator has looked it up (reported as new).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `08`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Leave Desc blank.
3. Press PF5 to save.
cases.expected: The save is rejected; the message line shows `Description is required.`, the cursor returns to the Desc field and no record is written.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE: state 'N', then IF TTDESCI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → MOVE WS-M-DESC-REQ TO ERRMSGO, MOVE -1 TO TTDESCL (no 3600-ADD-TTYP)

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and returns to the initial prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has typed Type Code `02` and some description text but has not saved.
cases.steps:
1. Type Type Code `02`, Desc `TEST TEXT`.
2. Press PF4.
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed cleared: Type Code and Desc are blank; the message line shows `Enter a type code and press ENTER.`; the state returns to key-entry ('K') so any prior lookup is discarded.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTTYPAO, state 'K', WS-M-PROMPT)

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF9 (an unsupported key).
cases.expected: The action is rejected; the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.` and the screen stays on the maintenance map awaiting a supported key (ENTER / PF3 / PF4 / PF5).
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → MOVE WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO ERRMSGO → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Two-step maintenance: key-entry to record-loaded to saved across pseudo-conversational turns
cases.precondition: F-STD. Type code `02` exists on file (PAYMENT).
cases.steps:
1. On the key-entry screen enter Type Code `02` and press ENTER (first turn).
2. The record is loaded; change Desc to `PAYMENT RECEIVED` and press PF5 (second turn).
cases.expected: After ENTER the state moves from key-entry to record-loaded (existing) and the message line shows `Type found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; after PF5 the change is saved and the message line shows `Transaction type updated.`; the key and state are carried between turns by the pseudo-conversational commarea, so the second turn knows the record was already looked up.
cases.remark: state CA-WORK-AREA(1:1): 'K'→'E' (2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND) → save (2300-SAVE state 'E' → 3500-UPDATE-TTYP) · 9000-RETURN TRANSID(ORTT) COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: First entry shows the initial screen; an established session routes to input processing
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORTT with no commarea (first entry) and observe the screen.
2. From the displayed screen enter Type Code `01` and press ENTER (an established session).
cases.expected: On the first entry (no commarea) the initial key-entry screen is shown with `Enter a type code and press ENTER.`; on the next turn, because the session is now established, ENTER is routed to input processing and the code `01` is looked up (PURCHASE) rather than re-showing the blank screen.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: IF EIBCALEN=0 INITIALIZE + 1000-SEND-INITIAL; ELSE EVALUATE — WHEN CA-FIRST-ENTER (context 0) → 1000-SEND-INITIAL, WHEN OTHER → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT · 1000 sets CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up an existing transaction type and open it for maintenance
cases.precondition: F-STD. Type code `01` exists on file with description `PURCHASE`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The type is found; its description `PURCHASE` is shown in the Desc field; the message line shows `Type found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; the cursor moves to the Desc field so the operator can change it and save with PF5.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-TTYP RESP(NORMAL) REC-FOUND · MOVE TT-DESC TO TTDESCO · state 'E' · MOVE -1 TO TTDESCL · WS-M-FOUND · TTYPFILE (transaction-type file)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up a code not on file and open it as a new type
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `08`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `08`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The code is reported as new; the Desc field is left blank ready for entry; the message line shows `New type. Enter text, PF5 to add.`; the cursor moves to the Desc field so the operator can type a description and add it with PF5.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-TTYP RESP(NOTFND) REC-NOT-FOUND · MOVE WS-TT-CD TO TTCDO, MOVE SPACES TO TTDESCO · state 'N' (WS-ST-NEW) · WS-M-NEW

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Add a new transaction type
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `08`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `08` and press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `CHARGEBACK`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.expected: A new type record is added to the transaction-type file with description `CHARGEBACK`; the message line shows `Transaction type added.`; the state becomes existing so a further PF5 would update the same record.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE (state 'N') → 3600-ADD-TTYP WRITE RESP(NORMAL) · WS-M-ADDED · MOVE WS-ST-EXIST TO CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) · TTYPFILE

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change the description of an existing transaction type
cases.precondition: F-STD. Type code `03` exists on file with description `CASH ADVANCE`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `03` and press ENTER (reported as found).
2. Change Desc to `CASH ADVANCE FEE`.
3. Press PF5 to update.
cases.data: Type Code=03, new Desc=CASH ADVANCE FEE
cases.expected: The type record is updated in place with the new description `CASH ADVANCE FEE`; the message line shows `Transaction type updated.`; the key is unchanged.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE (state 'E') → 3500-UPDATE-TTYP READ UPDATE + REWRITE RESP(NORMAL) · MOVE TTDESCI TO TT-DESC · WS-M-UPDATED

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Added record carries the exact key, description and initialised filler
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `09`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09` and press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `PROMOTIONAL CREDIT`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
4. Inspect the written record on file.
cases.expected: The written record holds Type Cd `09`, Desc `PROMOTIONAL CREDIT` (left-justified, space-padded to 50) and the 8-byte trailing filler cleared to spaces; the message line shows `Transaction type added.`
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TTYP: INITIALIZE TTYP-REC → MOVE WS-TT-CD TO TT-CD + MOVE TTDESCI TO TT-DESC → WRITE · RTTYP layout TT-CD X(2) + TT-DESC X(50) + FILLER X(8)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Pressing PF5 twice after an add updates the same record instead of duplicating it
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `10` at the start.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `10`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `FOREIGN FEE` and press PF5 (added).
3. Without changing the key, change Desc to `FOREIGN TXN FEE` and press PF5 again.
cases.data: Type Code=10, Desc=FOREIGN FEE then FOREIGN TXN FEE
cases.expected: The first PF5 adds the record (`Transaction type added.`) and flips the state to existing; the second PF5 updates the same record rather than creating a duplicate, and the message line shows `Transaction type updated.`; only one record for `10` exists on file.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TTYP sets state 'E' after WRITE NORMAL → subsequent 2300-SAVE takes the state 'E' branch → 3500-UPDATE-TTYP REWRITE · idempotent

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: An update preserves the key and is visible on a fresh lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. Type code `04` exists on file with description `INTEREST`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `04`, press ENTER (found).
2. Change Desc to `INTEREST CHARGE` and press PF5 (updated).
3. Press PF4 to clear, then re-enter Type Code `04` and press ENTER.
cases.expected: The re-lookup returns the same key `04` with the updated description `INTEREST CHARGE`; the message line shows `Type found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; the key was not altered by the update.
cases.remark: 3500-UPDATE-TTYP REWRITE (key from RIDFLD unchanged, only TT-DESC changed) → re-read 2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND shows new TT-DESC

cases.mid: 排他・同時実行 (Exclusion / concurrent access)
cases.name: A save that collides with an already-existing key reports a save error
cases.precondition: F-STD. A code looked up as new is created by another task before this operator's PF5 (so the add hits a duplicate). *(needs concurrent/fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `11`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Another task adds code `11` in the meantime.
3. Type Desc `PENDING TYPE` and press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=11, Desc=PENDING TYPE *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The add fails because the key already exists (duplicate); the message line shows `Error saving the transaction type.` and no second record is created; the same message also covers a rewrite that returns a non-normal response.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TTYP WRITE RESP(DUPREC) / WHEN OTHER → WS-M-SAVE-ERR; also 3500-UPDATE-TTYP REWRITE non-NORMAL → WS-M-SAVE-ERR · runtime/contention

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Pressing PF5 to save before looking up a code is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry (state 'K'); no ENTER lookup has been done yet.
cases.steps:
1. On the fresh screen type Type Code `01` and Desc `SOME TEXT`.
2. Press PF5 (without pressing ENTER first).
cases.data: Type Code=01, Desc=SOME TEXT (no prior ENTER)
cases.expected: The save is rejected because the code has not been looked up; the message line shows `Enter a type code and press ENTER first.` and the cursor returns to the Type Code field; nothing is written.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE guard: IF CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) NOT = 'E' AND NOT = 'N' → WS-M-KEY-FIRST, MOVE -1 TO TTCDL (state still 'K')

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unrecoverable file error ends the transaction with a support message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction-type file is unavailable or returns an I/O error on read. *(needs fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`.
2. Press ENTER while the file read returns an unrecoverable error.
cases.data: Type Code=01 (file I/O forced to error) *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The program cannot continue and aborts the transaction, sending the full-screen text `OCTTYP: unrecoverable file error. Contact support.` and ending the task without resuming the maintenance screen.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-TTYP / 3500-UPDATE-TTYP EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → 9500-ABEND-RTN: SEND TEXT WS-MSG-TEXT ERASE FREEKB + RETURN · runtime/env fault

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-character type code is accepted and matched exactly (no zero padding)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Codes are stored two characters wide as `01`..`07`.
cases.steps:
1. In Type Code type just `1` (one of the two positions).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The one-character code is accepted (it is not blank, so the required check passes) but is matched exactly as `1 ` (digit + space), which does not equal the stored key `01`; the code is therefore reported as new and the message line shows `New type. Enter text, PF5 to add.` — confirming there is no leading-zero normalisation.
cases.remark: TTCD map length 2; 2100-LOOKUP MOVE TTCDI TO WS-TT-CD + INSPECT LOW-VALUE→SPACE → '1 ' ≠ '01' → 3000-READ-TTYP REC-NOT-FOUND → WS-M-NEW · min length 1

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A full two-character code is accepted at its maximum length
cases.precondition: F-STD. Type code `07` exists on file (ADJUSTMENT).
cases.steps:
1. In Type Code type both positions `07`.
2. Press ENTER.
3. Attempt to type a third character into the code field.
cases.expected: The two-character code fills the field and is found; the description `ADJUSTMENT` is shown and the message line shows `Type found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; a third character cannot be typed because the code field holds exactly two positions (maximum length 2).
cases.remark: TTCD BMS length 2 (max) · 2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND · MOVE TT-DESC TO TTDESCO · WS-M-FOUND

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A non-numeric two-character code is accepted as a new code (no format or range check)
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `AB`.
cases.steps:
1. In Type Code type `AB`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=AB (letters; also representative of any out-of-seed value such as `99`)
cases.expected: The letters `AB` are accepted with no numeric or range check on the code; the key is looked up and reported as new; the message line shows `New type. Enter text, PF5 to add.`, so any two characters can be keyed as a code.
cases.remark: no validation on TTCD other than blank (2100-LOOKUP) — the raw X(2) value is used as the RIDFLD key; 'AB' not on file → REC-NOT-FOUND → WS-M-NEW

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A description at the maximum 50 characters is accepted and stored
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `09`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type a 50-character Desc `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.expected: The full 50-character description fills the field and is stored without truncation; the message line shows `Transaction type added.`
cases.remark: TTDESC map length 50 = TT-DESC PIC X(50) · 3600-ADD-TTYP MOVE TTDESCI TO TT-DESC (max length)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-character description is accepted and stored
cases.precondition: F-STD. No type exists for code `10`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `10`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type a one-character Desc `X`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.expected: The one-character description is accepted (it is not blank, so the required check passes) and stored as `X` padded with spaces; the message line shows `Transaction type added.`
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE: TTDESCI not blank → passes desc-required · 3600-ADD-TTYP WRITE NORMAL · min non-blank length 1

cases.mid: 回復・リラン (Recovery / rerun)
cases.name: Pressing ENTER with nothing transmitted is handled as empty input
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is fresh at key-entry; the operator types nothing.
cases.steps: 1. Without typing anything, press ENTER.
cases.expected: The empty transmit is treated as blank input (the receive maps it to low-values); the required-field check fires and the message line shows `Type code is required.`, leaving the operator on the key-entry screen to try again.
cases.remark: 2050-RECEIVE: IF WS-RESP-CD = DFHRESP(MAPFAIL) MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTTYPAI → 2100-LOOKUP sees TTCDI LOW-VALUES → WS-M-CD-REQ

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: PF3 returns control to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed (any state).
cases.steps: 1. On the maintenance screen press PF3.
cases.expected: Control is handed back to the main menu program (OCMENU); the commarea (with the originating program `OCTTYP` and transaction `ORTT` recorded) is passed along so the menu can display; the maintenance screen is left.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU: MOVE WS-PGMNAME/WS-TRANID TO CA-FROM-*, CA-PGM-CONTEXT=0, EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(WS-MENU-PGM='OCMENU') COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA)
